inline_text: The form had two fields with the same label: "Any existing work, prior art, competing or related initiatives?" One is in the Resources section (id: existing_work) and one is in Supporting Materials (id: supporting_documents). The second was renamed to "Supporting documents or attachments" to match its actual purpose.
